name: Clify
description: Calls 135 public websites — package registries, weather, transit, government and science data — as typed JSON commands over a keyless hosted MCP server covering 1,619 verified commands.

skills.name: Site Catalogue Search
skills.description: Searches the catalogue of 135 covered websites by keyword so an agent can find which site handles a given lookup.

skills.name: Command Schema Lookup
skills.description: Lists a site's commands with required params, allowed values and defaults so a call can be formed correctly first time.

skills.name: Typed Command Call
skills.description: Calls one command of a site and returns JSON; field and limit args trim the payload, and writes need confirm:true.

skills.name: Package Registry Lookup
skills.description: Dedicated calls for crates.io crate details and PyPI package metadata, returning version, downloads and install info.

skills.name: Wikipedia And HN Search
skills.description: Dedicated calls for Wikipedia article summaries and Hacker News story or comment search through hn.algolia.com.
